instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet together, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Take a large step to the right, bending the right knee and pushing your hips back.
3. Lower until the right thigh is near parallel to the floor, keeping the left leg straight and the left foot flat.
4. Push through the right heel to return to the start.
5. Repeat on the left side, alternating each rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back flat; do not round forward.
2. Sit your hips back so the working knee tracks over the foot.
3. Keep the trailing leg straight to stretch the inner thigh.
4. Push through the heel, not the toes.
name: Dumbbell side lunge alternating

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet together, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step out to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips back.
3. Lower until the working thigh is near parallel to the floor, keeping the other leg straight and its foot flat.
4. Push through the heel to return to the start.
5. Complete your reps on one side, then switch to the other.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back flat; do not round forward.
2. Sit your hips back so the working knee tracks over the foot.
3. Keep the straight leg extended to stretch the inner thigh.
4. Push through the heel, not the toes.
name: Dumbbell side lunge left n right

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet together, holding one dumbbell with both hands at your chest.
2. Step out to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips back.
3. Lower until the working thigh is near parallel to the floor, keeping the other leg straight and its foot flat.
4. Push through the heel to return to the start.
5. Complete your reps on one side, then switch to the other.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hold the dumbbell tight to your chest to keep your torso upright.
2. Sit your hips back so the working knee tracks over the foot.
3. Keep the straight leg extended to stretch the inner thigh.
4. Brace your core to resist twisting toward the weight.
name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Single Leg

instructions:
1. Lie on your side on a bench or the floor, legs stacked, lower arm supporting your head.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, arm resting along your side.
3. Raise the dumbbell toward the ceiling with a near-straight arm until your arm is roughly vertical.
4. Lower the dumbbell back to your side with control.
5. Complete your reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with the elbow and keep a slight bend to protect the joint.
2. Move slowly to keep tension on the side delt and avoid swinging.
3. Keep your core tight so your torso does not roll back.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise

instructions:
1. Set up in a side plank on one elbow, elbow under the shoulder, body in a straight line.
2. Hold a dumbbell in the top hand, arm hanging down toward the floor.
3. Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
4. Raise the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc until your arm is near parallel to the floor.
5. Lower the dumbbell with control while holding the plank.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips lifted and body straight; do not let the hips sag.
2. Squeeze the shoulder blades to drive the fly, not momentum.
3. Use a light weight so trunk stability stays solid.
4. Brace your obliques throughout to resist collapsing.
name: Dumbbell Side Plank with Rear Fly
